'''Coral-shaping''',<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> also known as '''coral-sculpting''',<ref name="TSoK">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref> was the practice of growing sculptures made of [[Coral/Legends|coral]]. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] both practiced the art.<ref name="Strongholds" /> The [[Akwin]] of [[Lazerian IV]] also partook in coral-sculpting.<ref name="TSoK" />
